notes_for_editor: Only the NHLR page gives history; the second and third searches found no independent source for the 1930s date or the 1974 watching arrangement. The Register says only 'the 1930s', so the built event uses year 1930 as a stand-in for the decade, and modified uses 1980 the same way. Coordinates appear on the FFLA Virginia list, but the NHLR says the owner asked that they be unlisted. The story omits them and the record should be reviewed. Owner and watching family are not named in the story. The brief's 'Private owner' and standing status are supported.
